As the game expands in size and quality, packaging each update becomes more challenging. This latest update was particularly difficult due to the numerous bug fixes requested by real players.

notes.title: Minor Update: Version 2.0.5
notes.notes:
Introducing Version 2.0.5 update! 

Overall performance update: 
- Lightmap resolution settings were 4k+, but reduced to 64 - 500. It looks less realistic, but feels much smoother! Please send feedback if you are experiencing FPS issues! It will be much appreciated!

Future Plans for HellFull - The Last Hope

Graphics, Resolutions, Textures, Lighting, etc. :
- All these settings will be set back to max, once everyone is able to afford good PC's 10 years from now! Hopefully less! For now, enjoy this game with a passion! Experience your freedom in the world, which is HellFull - The Last Hope! 

Quote: "Express yourself honestly!" - Bruce Lee

Linux:
HellFull - The Last Hope is being played by Linux users, but the performance packaging is still a work in progress (source, C++ and more are being worked on). It will be made official on the Steam Store soon to be seen internationally!

Multiplayer
- Multiplayer vs AI bots is disabled till next update Version 2.0.6.
- Multiplayer replication is a few updates away!
- Online Multiplayer is a work in progress. 

(My goal is reaching 100k downloads soon, so that I will be able to make this possible even faster! I need a new computer ASAP! If I had a ThreadRipper, I will Rip and Tear through these updates! Quick!... I am doing this for you guys who really believe in the future of this unique game!)

Overall player improvements on controls: It will feel a lot smoother and natural now! 

Cross-Platform Controller Support: HellFull - The Last Hope is destined for Xbox! This request was made by hundreds of supporters (hundreds of Steam Whishlist supporters, and messages received by them). Is currently the most requested update by miles! Please be patient as I am working tirelessly (until I am able to hire a team for help!) working to get this ready! I appreciate each and every single Sale and Whishlist!
